On this maize plot, I will keep costs low because fertilizer is expensive for me and here in Kigoma many of us still farm mainly with the rains and hand hoe. I will plant my usual local seed and use some manure if I can gather it, but I do not expect to buy chemical inputs or spray chemicals this season. The plot will depend on family work, though I may hire a few laborers for peak work like weeding.
